raid.jaymoskingdoms.warning.0: Word from upstairs: the watch is coming. Drink up and get out.
raid.jaymoskingdoms.warning.1: Somebody's talked. Guards on their way. If you're leaving, leave now.
raid.jaymoskingdoms.warning.2: Boots on the street, heading this way. Nobody here saw anything, understand?
raid.jaymoskingdoms.muster.0: Right, lads. The hatch by the hay bale. Nobody gets out.
raid.jaymoskingdoms.muster.1: We know where it is now. With me.
raid.jaymoskingdoms.muster.2: On the captain's word: we're clearing out that rat hole tonight.
raid.jaymoskingdoms.burst.1: Hands where I can see them! This den is closed!
raid.jaymoskingdoms.burst.2: In the name of the crown, stand still!
raid.jaymoskingdoms.taken.0: All right, all right. I'm coming.
raid.jaymoskingdoms.taken.1: I only pour the drinks, I swear it.
raid.jaymoskingdoms.taken.2: You'll get nothing out of me.
smuggle.jaymoskingdoms.search.0: Hold up. What's under those sacks?
smuggle.jaymoskingdoms.search.1: Potatoes, is it? Let's have a look.
smuggle.jaymoskingdoms.search.2: That's not wheat. That's coming with us.
smuggle.jaymoskingdoms.caught.0: Never seen it before in my life.
smuggle.jaymoskingdoms.caught.1: Somebody must have put that there.
smuggle.jaymoskingdoms.caught.2: Fine. Take it. I'll be on my way.
smuggle.jaymoskingdoms.cover.1: Wheat and spuds for the market. Nothing for you.
smuggle.jaymoskingdoms.cover.2: Not for sale. It's spoken for.
smuggle.jaymoskingdoms.sold.0: From under the sacks. You didn't get it from me.
smuggle.jaymoskingdoms.sold.1: A friend of the back room. Here, quick.
smuggle.jaymoskingdoms.sold.2: Keep it out of sight till you're off the road.
smuggle.jaymoskingdoms.short: Not enough coin for that, friend.
message.jaymoskingdoms.smuggle.robbed: You broke open a smuggler's handcart. Nobody's going to the law about this one.
news.jaymoskingdoms.underworld.raided: The watch of %s raided the back room under the town and shut it. Its fence and his people were taken before the law.
news.jaymoskingdoms.underworld.raid_beat: The watch of %s raided a back room under the town and was beaten back.
news.jaymoskingdoms.underworld.spread: Travellers say the smugglers have reached %s. There's a back room there now, dealing in %s.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.133: A back room that runs too hot draws the watch. When the fence says boots are on the street, get up the ladder before they come down it.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.134: Smugglers push handcarts of potatoes between the cities with back rooms. A fence will hand you a sealed bundle to run yourself, and pay well at the far end, if the guards don't see it first.
